labels.text: Section 1(j)(5)(B): the maximum zero rate amount for any other individual other than an estate or trust, including a married individual filing separately (section 1(j)(5)(B)(i)(III): one half of the amount in subclause (I)). Statutory amount for taxable years beginning in 2018; 2025 and 2026 are the Revenue Procedure figures. Years between the anchored rows are NOT pinned in this package: evaluation returns MISSING_PARAMETER_VALUE there instead of a fabricated indexed figure (the section 1(j)(5)(C) mechanism is `section_1j5_indexed_amount`, which needs the C-CPI-U facts).
section 1(j)(5)(B): the statutory dollar amount (unindexed, taxable years beginning in 2018)
Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.03: the amount for taxable years beginning in 2025
Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.03: the amount for taxable years beginning in 2026
